newsitem.title: UK: Mirror resigns from UK NPA publishers'group.
newsitem.headline: Mirror resigns from UK NPA publishers'group.

text.p: The Mirror Group Plc said on Monday it had "reluctantly" reached a decision to resign its membership of the Newspaper Publishers Association (NPA) with immediate effect.
The company said it had found the NPA unsupportive of its aims both individually and collectively for the industry.
"We do not wish to be a member of a club where other members unproductively spend their time stabbing each other in the back," said chief executive David Montgomery in a statement.
The company said its decision to resign from the NPA should not be seen as any reflection on the NPA's chairman, deputy chairman, director or staff.
